issues.title: Digital Storage Oscilloscope Station 2 Faulty Ch-1
issues.description: Station 2 channel 1 vertical gain knob is loose and calibration fails.

timeline.note: Issue submitted by student. Assigned to Er. Sreejith K. (Hardware Lab Superintendent) for initial assessment.
Technician dispatched to bench. Replacement attenuator knob issued from stores.

issues.title: Station 4 Oscilloscope Ground Noise & Broken Probe
issues.description: Station 4 100MHz probe attenuation switch broken. Second channel has heavy 50Hz ground noise during SPI signal capture.

timeline.note: Issue registered and assigned to Hardware Lab Committee.
Inspected workstation. 100MHz replacement probe requisitioned from department stores.

issues.title: Arm GNU Toolchain Missing on Workstations 14 to 18
issues.description: GCC Arm toolchain environment path unset on machines 14-18 following snapshot rollback.

timeline.note: Issue logged and assigned to Systems Admin.
Ansible playbook pushed across lab subnet. Environment paths fixed and test compilation verified.
Issue marked as Resolved after confirming with student batch rep.

issues.title: Classroom 301 Projector HDMI Audio Intermittent Failure
issues.description: Podium HDMI connection cuts audio transmission to wall speakers intermittently during presentation videos.

timeline.note: Ticket scheduled for AV technician inspection during 12:30 PM recess.

issues.title: Insufficient Lighting Near Western Staircase of Hardware Block
issues.description: Two corridor LED batten lights are non-functional near the western exit staircase, causing safety hazards during evening lab sessions.

timeline.note: Work order sent to Electrical Maintenance Section for bulb replacement.

suggestions.title: Add Microchip Soldering Stations for FYP Teams
suggestions.idea: Provide 2 additional temperature-controlled soldering stations with fume extractors in Lab H-101.
suggestions.officialResponse: Submitted to Welfare Committee for agenda review.

suggestions.title: Introduce Weekend Open-Lab Hours for Capstone Robotics Projects
suggestions.idea: Allow final and pre-final year students access to the Robotics & IoT Lab on Saturdays with prior faculty permission for robot hardware assembly and calibration.
suggestions.officialResponse: Approved by HOD. Lab H-101 and R-204 are now open Saturdays 9:30 AM - 1:30 PM under supervision of Er. Deepa Mohan.

suggestions.title: Set up a Dedicated Component Lending Library for Small Sensors & Boards
suggestions.idea: Create a fast self-checkout cupboard for basic sensor modules (ultrasonic, IMU, motor drivers) so students do not have to wait days for minor hardware testing.
suggestions.officialResponse: Department stores currently compiling inventory. Dedicated fast-checkout shelf being installed in Lab H-101.

suggestions.title: Conduct Peer-to-Peer Linux & ROS2 Crash Course for S4 Juniors
suggestions.idea: Senior S6/S8 students can conduct a 2-day evening workshop helping juniors set up dual-boot Ubuntu and ROS2 on their personal laptops before lab classes begin.
suggestions.officialResponse: Welfare committee discussing date with Student Association for early October.

events.title: HackCPS 2026: 36-Hour National IoT & Cyber-Physical Systems Hackathon
events.venue: GECT Central Auditorium & CPS IoT Fabrication Lab
events.organizer: Association of Cyber Physical Systems (ACPS) x IEDC GECT
events.speaker: Mentorship by Bosch Global Software & Texas Instruments
events.description: Flagship 36-hour national offline hackathon inviting developers, hardware hackers, and innovators across India. Build real-time IoT, autonomous edge robotics, automotive ECU firmware, and smart grid solutions. Free food, hardware components, overnight lab access, and high-speed Wi-Fi provided.
highlights: ₹65,000 Total Prize Pool (1st: ₹35,000, 2nd: ₹20,000, Best CPS Hardware: ₹10,000)
Complimentary hardware kits: ESP32-S3, STM32 Nucleo, sensor arrays
Direct internship interviews with industry jury members
Free accommodation in campus guest rooms for external teams
events.eligibility: Open to all B.Tech / M.Tech students across India (teams of 2-4)

events.title: Hands-On ROS2 Humble & Autonomous Mobile Robotics Workshop
events.speaker: Er. Rahul Krishnan (Senior Robotics Engineer, ASIMOV Robotics)
events.description: Intensive hands-on training covering ROS2 architecture, publisher-subscriber nodes, Gazebo physical simulation, LIDAR SLAM mapping, and Nav2 navigation on TurtleBot3 mobile robots.
highlights: Work directly with 2D LIDAR sensors and Differential Drive robots
ROS2 navigation stack setup and autonomous waypoint following
KTU Activity Points certificates for all registered participants
events.eligibility: CPS & ECE / EEE / MECH students (pre-requisite: Python/C++)

events.title: Firmware Security & Hardware CTF Challenge (Bug Hunt 26)
events.organizer: CPS Cyber Security Cell x FOSS GECT
events.speaker: Coordinated by Dr. Anoop V. & Cyber Security Alumni
events.description: Test your skills in reverse-engineering binary firmware, SPI flash dumping, side-channel analysis, and exploiting CAN bus vulnerabilities in simulated automotive environments.
highlights: Real embedded hardware targets (routers, IoT cameras, CAN simulator)
Categories: Firmware RE, Hardware Glitching, Cryptography, Network Forensics
Prizes for Top 3 teams + Best Freshman Hacker Award
events.eligibility: Open to all KTU engineering college students

events.title: CYBERNETICS 26: Annual National Technical Symposium
events.venue: GECT Main Auditorium, Seminar Halls SH-1 & SH-2
events.organizer: Department of Cyber Physical Systems & ACPS
events.speaker: Keynotes by Dr. R. Ramanathan (IIT Madras) & Dr. Anita Nair (IISc)
events.description: The premier annual technical festival of the Department of Cyber Physical System Engineering. Featuring IEEE-indexed student paper presentations, drone racing league, robo-wars, industry panel discussions, and project exhibitions.
highlights: IEEE Track: Peer-reviewed research presentations with proceedings
National Drone Racing League & Line Follower Championship
Industry Expo with 15+ tech enterprise stalls and hiring booths
events.eligibility: National participation from all engineering disciplines

events.title: Masterclass: Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) in Electric Vehicles
events.speaker: Arun Mohan (Lead Architect - Battery Management Systems, Ather Energy)
events.description: In-depth engineering masterclass on FreeRTOS task scheduling, MISRA-C safety compliance, CAN-FD communication protocols, and thermal management in electric two-wheelers.
highlights: Live trace demonstration with logic analyzer on battery ECU
Career pathways in automotive embedded systems
Q&A session on KTU M.Tech & B.Tech capstone project ideas
events.eligibility: Open to all S5/S7 students and M.Tech scholars
